newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta shares end sharply down on weak sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta shares end sharply down on weak sentiment.

text.p: Jakarta shares ended 1.41 percent down on Thursday following weak market sentiment which prompted profit-taking almost across the board, brokers said.
Analysts and brokers said the profit-taking emerged on a range of blue-chips which had risen sharply in recent days.
The Jakarta Composite Index fell 8.77 points, or 1.41 percent to close at 611.50 points. Losers led gainers by 85 to 34, with 49 counters unchanged.
Brokers said sentiment was likely to remain weak on Thursday as the market lacked positive news. But some added good corporate results were likely from a few selected companies.

"I heard Indofood and Indocement will announce nine-month results tomorrow (Friday) but the impact on overall market sentiment will be limited," a foreign analyst said. Another broker said some investors would be sidelined on Friday awaiting better sentiment while others would continue cashing out.
Blue-chips hit by profit-taking included the exchange's most heavily weighted stock Telkom, which fell 100 rupiah to 3,825 on 2.4 million shares traded.
Satellite operator Indosat lost 250 rupiah to 6,550 on 4.6 million shares traded.
Newly-listed Bank Negara Indonesia topped the active list with 13.7 million shares changing hands, and ended unchanged at 1,175 rupiah after touching a low of 1,150 rupiah.
Secondary chemical firm Aneka Kimia was also actively traded with 7.4 million shares changing hands, but fell 50 rupiah to 1,400 due to profit-taking, brokers said.
